result.markdown:
For most small businesses, **Gusto is my top recommendation** if you're operating in the United States. It combines payroll processing, automatic tax calculations and filings, employee onboarding, benefits administration, and HR tools in one relatively easy-to-use platform.

However, the best choice depends on your business size, location, and whether you have hourly employees, salaried employees, or contractors.

## Important: If your business is in Canada

If you're operating in Canada, I would choose a different shortlist. U.S. payroll products such as Gusto aren't necessarily suitable for Canadian payroll compliance.

Consider these Canadian options\:

- **Wagepoint** – Canadian payroll, tax deductions, remittances, and year-end reporting. [Website](https://wagepoint.com/)\.
- **PaymentEvolution** – Canadian payroll and payment processing. [Website](https://www.paymentevolution.com/)\.
- **ADP Canada** – Payroll, tax compliance, and HR services. [Website](https://www.adp.ca/)\.

For a small Canadian business, I'd start by comparing Wagepoint and PaymentEvolution.

## My recommendation

Since you're likely comparing options in the Canadian market, I'd narrow it down this way\:

| Your situation | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| Small business, straightforward payroll | Wagepoint |
| Already use QuickBooks | QuickBooks Payroll |
| Want payroll and HR together | Knit or Humi |
| Quebec-based business | Wagepoint or Nethris |
| Want more hands-on payroll support | Payworks |


**One important consideration for Quebec\:** Make sure your provider handles QPP, QPIP, Quebec income tax, Revenu Québec remittances, T4s and RL-1 slips. search_results.description: The article reviews payroll platforms for small businesses in 2026, assessing features, pricing, usability, integrations, documentation, and customer support. Gusto is its top dependable choice, combining full-service payroll, tax compliance, benefits, and accounting integrations. Xero stands out for accounting and app integrations, while QuickBooks is recommended for mobile payroll. Paychex suits businesses seeking outsourced HR and benefits administration; Rippling offers flexible, scalable HR, payroll, IT, and expense tools. Remote Payroll supports international hiring and compliance, and Zoho People bundles payroll with a broad HR and business ecosystem. Other picks include PeopleHR for UK SMEs, Patriot Payroll for straightforward value, BambooHR for ease of use, Hourly for time tracking and workers’ compensation, 1st Money for small UK businesses (free for fewer than 10 employees), Breathe HR for simplified HR, and Employment Hero for advanced features. The article also highlights ADP’s payroll and HR services. It advises choosing software based on business size and required features, prioritizing compliance, integrations, transparent pricing, employee self-service, and responsive support.
